ns2:section.sectionText: Improvisation: COLAB is an interdisciplinary, collaborative workshop of musicians and dancers, fusing improvisation and composition, co-taught by Erik Lund (Music Composition, Performance) and Kirstie Simson (Dance). Work in class will include sharing and adapting the principles and elements from music and dance with a focus on producing material that will be presented in public performances throughout the semester. For instructor approval contact Erik Lund, eriklund@illinois.edu.
